title: English Conversation 50:  Wrong Flowers
content: 1. an anniversary: a celebration on the same day that some important event happened in the past - It is our 10th wedding anniversary. - Today is the 2nd anniversary of the day we met for the first time. 2. an error: a mistake - The boss doesn't like him because he makes many errors. - Is this number right? It looks too big. I think it is an error. 3. flower bouquet: a bunch of flowers arranged in a pretty way - Women love to get a flower bouquet. - I will get my wife a flower bouquet because she is angry at me.
